items.summary: Redesign the entire frontend visual theme to use a saffron (deep orange #FF6B00), gold (#FFD700), red (#C0392B), and warm yellow (#FFA500) devotional color palette. Replace the dark theme with a warm, light-to-rich devotional aesthetic inspired by Hindu temple decor — think marigold garlands, temple brass, and sacred fire. Apply consistent saffron/gold gradients to headers, cards, and section backgrounds. Use cream/off-white (#FFF8E7) as the base background.

Redesign the Profile and Panchang pages (frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx, frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx) with the devotional saffron/gold theme. Panchang data cells should use warm amber/cream card styling with gold borders. Profile page should use saffron accents for mantra selection and stats display.

Redesign the Home page (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx) with a grand devotional hero banner featuring an Om symbol, Sanskrit greeting text, and the current Panchang tithi displayed prominently. Include beautifully styled category cards for Mantras/Shlokas, Aarti, Puja Vidhi, and Bhajans with deity icons/emojis. Display the Daily Dharma Quote and a featured Shloka card in an ornate card style with gold borders.

Redesign the AppLayout (frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx) header to feature a saffron-to-gold gradient background with the Om (ॐ) logo in gold, app name in Devanagari-style typography, and subtle mandala/floral decorative elements. Remove all dark styling from the header.

Redesign the BottomNav (frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx) with a warm cream/saffron background, gold active state indicators, and saffron icon highlights. Active navigation items should glow with a soft golden halo effect.

Redesign all page-level containers and card components (AartiCard, KathaCard, ShlokaCard, FestivalCountdownCard, DailyDharmaQuote) with warm devotional styling: gold/saffron borders, cream or warm gradient card backgrounds, ornate corner flourishes via CSS, and saffron-tinted section headers in Devanagari-inspired typography.

Redesign the Jap counter page (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx) with a devotional sacred atmosphere: saffron/gold background gradient, the MalaRing rendered with gold/amber beads, mantra text displayed in large Sanskrit/Devanagari styling in saffron, and the count displayed in an ornate golden circle. The LotusBloomOverlay should use bright golden/saffron colors.

Redesign the Aarti pages (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx and frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx) with a devotional temple aesthetic: saffron hero banner with diya/flame imagery, gold-bordered aarti text cards, and warm amber/saffron background throughout. Aarti text should be displayed with high readability using dark maroon on cream background.

Update the global CSS (frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js) to replace dark theme CSS custom properties with warm devotional light-theme values. Set the default color scheme to the saffron/gold palette. Ensure Tailwind devotional color tokens (saffron, gold, maroon, cream) are the primary palette used across the app. Remove dark mode class-based overrides that apply dark backgrounds.

Redesign the Kathayen and KathaDetail pages (frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx, frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx) with warm saffron/gold styling. Tab filters should use saffron active states. Story cards should use cream backgrounds with gold borders. The detail page should present katha text with comfortable reading typography in dark maroon on cream.
